rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize test parameters: fill threshold D122, max leak D120, overpressure limit D123
Detect pressure transmitter wire break or under-range (< -5.00 kPa)
Detect pack overpressure condition exceeding D123 threshold
Detect loss of supply air pressure while station is busy
Reset latched station alarms upon fault reset pushbutton press
Combine alarms or open E-stop into common fault M299 and drive fault beacon Y25
Allow manual pack venting via PB-2010 when Auto mode is not selected
Start ST20 auto sequence on pallet arrival when in Auto and station is healthy
Transition from clamping to filling once clamp closed switch confirmed
Run fill timeout timer T21 (8.0 s)
Raise fill timeout alarm M290 if fill timer expires before target pressure is reached
Transition from fill to stabilise once pack pressure reaches fill target
Run pressure stabilisation timer T22 (5.0 s)
Capture initial test pressure D100 into D110 upon timer T23 pulse
Transition from stabilise to test once stabilise timer T22 completes
Run test window timer T23 (10.0 s)
Capture final pressure D111 and calculate pressure drop D112
Evaluate leak test: set PASS flag M210 if drop <= limit, else set FAIL flag M211
Transition from test to vent step once test timer T23 completes
Abort active sequence to vent step and flag FAIL upon common fault condition
Run vent timer T200
Transition from vent to unclamp when vent timer done, pressure < 1.00 kPa, and sensor valid
Transition from unclamp to complete once clamp open switch is confirmed
Reset cycle complete step and release station busy flag when pallet exits test position
Energize clamp solenoid Y20 during clamping, filling, stabilise, test, and vent steps
Energize fill valve Y21 during fill step provided no common fault is active
Energize vent valve Y22 during vent step or on pack overpressure alarm
Output PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) signal to line controller during complete step
End of main program scan
